question: Across risk tolerance, compare the average rebalance amount, average rebalance shift (target minus current allocation %), and average rebalance count (0 for investors with no rebalancing actions) of investors.

WITH reb AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) r_amt, AVG(target_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) r_shift, COUNT(*) r_cnt FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001 GROUP BY investor_id)
SELECT p.risk_tolerance AS risk_tolerance,
       ROUND(AVG(rb.r_amt),2) AS avg_rebalance_amount,
       ROUND(AVG(rb.r_shift),2) AS avg_rebalance_shift,
       ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(rb.r_cnt,0)),2) AS avg_rebalance_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.investor_id) AS investor_count
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
     LEFT JOIN reb rb ON rb.investor_id=p.investor_id
GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance
ORDER BY p.risk_tolerance;

question: Across risk tolerance, compare the average net cash flow, average cash-flow amount, average total holding value, average total rebalance amount, and average goal progress of investors.

WITH cash AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) c_net, AVG(amount) c_avg, COUNT(*) c_cnt FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     hold AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(current_value) h_val, AVG(returns_pct) h_ret, SUM(current_value-cost) h_gain, SUM(dividends) h_div FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     reb AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) r_amt, AVG(target_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) r_shift, COUNT(*) r_cnt FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     goals AS (SELECT investor_id, AVG(progress_pct) g_prog, AVG(shortfall) g_short, AVG(avg_annual_return_pct) g_ret, AVG(avg_volatility_pct) g_vol FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 GROUP BY investor_id)
SELECT p.risk_tolerance AS risk_tolerance,
       ROUND(AVG(cf.c_net),2) AS avg_net_cash_flow,
       ROUND(AVG(cf.c_avg),2) AS avg_cashflow_amount,
       ROUND(AVG(ho.h_val),2) AS avg_holding_value,
       ROUND(AVG(rb.r_amt),2) AS avg_rebalance_amount,
       ROUND(AVG(g.g_prog),2) AS avg_goal_progress,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.investor_id) AS investor_count

question: List the top 10 investors ranked by a composite score (0-100 index) combining net cash flow, total rebalance amount, total sector investment and total scenario allocation shift (sum of new minus current allocation %). Over investors that have all 4 components, min-max normalise each component to 0-1, and take 100 times their equal-weighted mean; break ties by investor_id.
sql_query:
WITH cash AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) c_net FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     reb AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) r_amt FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     alloc AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(total_investment) a_inv FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     scen AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) s_shift FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     per AS (SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name,
                 cf.c_net AS net_cash_flow,
                 rb.r_amt AS rebalance_amount,
                 al.a_inv AS sector_investment,
                 sc.s_shift AS scenario_shift
              FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
              LEFT JOIN cash cf ON cf.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN reb rb ON rb.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN alloc al ON al.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN scen sc ON sc.investor_id=p.investor_id
              WHERE cf.c_net IS NOT NULL AND rb.r_amt IS NOT NULL AND al.a_inv IS NOT NULL AND sc.s_shift IS NOT NULL),
     b AS (SELECT MIN(net_cash_flow) mn_0, MAX(net_cash_flow) mx_0, MIN(rebalance_amount) mn_1, MAX(rebalance_amount) mx_1, MIN(sector_investment) mn_2, MAX(sector_investment) mx_2, MIN(scenario_shift) mn_3, MAX(scenario_shift) mx_3 FROM per)
SELECT per.investor_id, per.investor_name,
       ROUND(100.0*((net_cash_flow-b.mn_0)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_0-b.mn_0,0) + (rebalance_amount-b.mn_1)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_1-b.mn_1,0) + (sector_investment-b.mn_2)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_2-b.mn_2,0) + (scenario_shift-b.mn_3)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_3-b.mn_3,0))/4.0,2) AS composite_score,
       ROUND(per.net_cash_flow,2) AS net_cash_flow,
       ROUND(per.rebalance_amount,2) AS rebalance_amount,
       ROUND(per.sector_investment,2) AS sector_investment,
       ROUND(per.scenario_shift,2) AS scenario_shift
FROM per, b
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, per.investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

                 sc.s_shift AS scenario_shift,
                 g.g_short AS goal_shortfall
              FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
              LEFT JOIN cash cf ON cf.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN reb rb ON rb.investor_id=p.investor_id

question: For investors with an average goal progress above 30 and a risk score above 50, what is the average holding return (counting only holdings with a recorded cost and current value) by risk tolerance?
